bullets.text: UK's First Neutral-Host 5G - Boldyn Networks launches 5G at Sunderland's Stadium of Light with **Virgin Media O2**.
Free VPN Risks Surge - The **Online Safety Act** drives users to risky free VPN services, exposing data to foreign servers.
Fibre Rollout Hits 80% - UK FTTP coverage approaches 80% as **Openreach** leads the charge in broadband expansion.
Full Fibre Adoption Soars - Despite a stagnant market, **full fibre** connections surge to over 11 million in the UK.
EE Dominates Mobile Network - **EE** retains its title as the UK's best mobile network for the twelfth consecutive year.
BT Expands Cloud Partnership - **BT Group** signs a five-year deal with **AWS** to enhance cloud services and customer experience.
Telcos Struggle with Disaggregation - Despite ambitions for disaggregated networks, only 5% of operators are in deployment.
